exposure: breech presentation of the second twin
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies where the first twin was delivered vaginally
finding: Risk factors for emergency cesarean section of the second twin after vaginal delivery of the first twin include preterm delivery, previous cesarean section, placental abruption, and breech presentation of the second twin.
mod_finding: Risk factors for emergency cesarean section of the second twin are preterm delivery, previous cesarean section, placental abruption, and breech presentation.
